baseline_models.focus_anchor: جعلنا ... في أعناقهم أغلالا ... إلى الأذقان ... مقمحون
baseline_models.mechanism: A made state becomes a neck-to-jaw restraint whose geometry produces the result named by مقمحون: the head is forced up and away from the water while the gaze and throat are constrained.

activation_trace.role: تصيير الشيء على حال supplies deliberate conversion into a constrained bodily state.
The anatomical neck supplies the central hinge between head and body.
The iron or leather collar that binds an organ supplies the restraining hardware.
The meeting of the jaws supplies the upper endpoint of the restraint.
Raising the head from water and abandoning drink supplies the resulting posture and deprivation.

changed_reading.after: The verse specifies a manufactured sensorimotor posture: neck, jaw, gaze, and access to drink are locked together by the two result clauses.

baseline_models.mechanism: Several focus branches converge on a blocked intake channel: a filter checks pouring, the protruding throat and jaw define the conduit, and مقمحون ranges across leaving drink, moving food from palm to mouth, and a mouthful.

activation_trace.role: A cloth that checks poured water supplies a valve-like image for the restraint.
The protruding end of the throat locates the constricted intake passage.
Leaving water after raising the head supplies failed drinking.
Casting food from the palm into the mouth supplies the hand-to-mouth route now obstructed.
A mouthful supplies the terminal capacity of the blocked route.

changed_reading.after: The collars also function as an intake shutoff at the throat and jaws, making nourishment present but inaccessible.

baseline_models.mechanism: The same root that names the visible collar also carries fixed ingress and concealed rancor. The object can therefore externalize an obstruction already embedded within, while the collective neck branch lets one posture propagate through a connected group.

activation_trace.role: Fixed entry into interstices supplies an obstruction lodged rather than merely hung on the body.
Latent rancor in the chest supplies an inward affective counterpart to the visible fetter.
A connected group or segment lets the plural necks register a socially shared posture.

changed_reading.before: An external captor imposes a device on separate bodies.
changed_reading.after: The device may be the visible form of an embedded, collectively reproduced rancor that has become bodily habit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fixed word before the focus, the front-and-back barriers and covering after it, and the closing command-speech-being sequence turn جعلنا into the material execution of a verdict. The neck restraint is the body's vertical component inside a temporal and spatial enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Conversion into a state anchors the focus as enacted rather than merely described.
A fixed, obligatory entailment supplies the verdict's binding force.
A thing's saying as its signification lets the word become legible as a bodily state.
Filling a gap and partitioning two sides extends the collar into front-and-back blockage.
A cover laid over a thing supplies the upper layer of the enclosure.
The split root's parallel covering branch reinforces concealment without collapsing its mapped inventory.
Literal eyesight names the faculty disabled by the completed enclosure.
Command as binding demand supplies the initiating force at the surah's close.
Uttered speech supplies the transition from command toward occurrence.
Occurrence in time completes the command-to-state mechanism.

structural_cues: 36:7 immediately precedes the focus, and 36:9 immediately extends its blockage before and behind.
The command-speech-being sequence at 36:82 forms a closing bookend for جعلنا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed word, made restraint, surrounding barriers, failed sight, and command becoming occurrence; I infer a verdict-to-enclosure arrow. A live alternative is that these are parallel descriptions rather than one execution sequence.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports one isolated punishment scene.
changed_reading.after: The collar is the bodily realization of a binding word and the vertical axis of an enclosure that closes time, space, and perception.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following requires directional responsiveness, while turning one's side away refuses it. The fixed raised head of مقمحون becomes an enacted orientation toward incoming signs rather than only an inability to move.

activation_trace.role: The raised head and withdrawn gaze supply a bodily orientation of non-reception.
Following in another's track supplies the responsive motion available to the receptive hearer.
Turning the side away supplies the volitional counterpart of the focus posture.

structural_cues: 36:11 identifies a follower as warnable, whereas 36:46 repeats habitual turning from every sign.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, turning away, and a fixed head posture; I infer that repeated refusal has congealed into anatomy. Alternatively, the bodily restraint may depict consequence without encoding prior volition.

changed_reading.before: The restrained people cannot orient themselves.
changed_reading.after: Their inability is also the stabilized bodily form of an orientation they repeatedly enacted: turning away instead of following.

context_deltas.mechanism: Focus branches place grain, hand-to-mouth transfer, and a mouthful behind a neck-and-throat shutoff. Later grain is eaten, while provision is supposed to move outward through spending and feeding. Refusal to release nourishment to others is mirrored as inability to receive it oneself.

activation_trace.role: The collar supplies both bodily prevention and the branch's extended sense of constriction or miserliness.
The throat endpoint locates the blocked passage of nourishment.
Wheat supplies the same grain later brought from revived earth.
Food moving from palm to mouth supplies the intake route.
A mouthful supplies the route's intended completion.
Seed that sprouts and bears grain supplies the available nourishment.
Taking food supplies successful completion of the route blocked in the focus.
Money going out in expenditure supplies the required outward flow.
An allotted gift supplies what is to circulate rather than be sealed off.
Feeding another supplies the social transfer explicitly refused.

structural_cues: 36:33 moves grain into eating; 36:47 tests whether provision will move from holder to hungry recipient.
The focus itself links collar, throat, jaw, and the قمح mouth-and-grain inventory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blocked intake, grain and eating, then refused spending and feeding; I supply the reciprocity arrow from blocked giving to blocked receiving. A live alternative is that alimentation and punishment are separate examples of ingratitude.

changed_reading.before: The collar deprives its wearer of food or drink.
changed_reading.after: It images a failed circulation of provision: hands that will not open nourishment outward belong to a body whose own hand-to-mouth channel is closed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The branch inventory of جميع supplies a fetter that gathers hands to the neck. The later sealed mouth and speaking, testifying limbs make that configuration juridical: ordinary speech is disabled while embodied evidence is retained and presented.

activation_trace.role: The neck supplies the gathering point for the later branch-defined fetter.
The literal collar supplies the restraint to which the hands can be gathered.
A fetter gathering the hands to the neck supplies an unexpectedly exact mechanical completion of the focus image.
A secured, preventing seal supplies the shutdown of ordinary testimony.
Opening the mouth for speech identifies the channel that the seal closes.
Intelligible speech transferred to the hands supplies an alternate evidentiary channel.
Declaration based on knowledge supplies the limbs' judicial function.

structural_cues: 36:53 gathers everyone for presentation; 36:65 redistributes speech from the sealed mouth to hands and feet.
The focus already places restraint at the neck and jaw.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact hand-to-neck fetter branch and a later transfer of testimony among body parts; I infer one courtroom apparatus. The alternative is that the جمع branch is a distant lexical echo and the scenes remain mechanically separate.

changed_reading.before: The collar merely immobilizes the neck.
changed_reading.after: It can gather the operative hands to the neck and hold the mouth shut while preserving the body as evidence for presentation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to separate supplies both sorting and, in a remote branch, extending the neck to display it. That convergence makes the raised neck of مقمحون a forced mark of public differentiation rather than private discomfort alone.

activation_trace.role: An elevated or elongated extension supplies the conspicuous neck profile.
The raised head supplies the visible posture.
Sorting a thing until distinct supplies judicial separation.
Extending the neck to make it visible supplies the display mechanism.

structural_cues: 36:59 directly addresses the criminals and commands their separation on that day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separation and neck-display branches under one root; I infer that the focus posture visibly marks the separated group. The live alternative is that neck display is an unrelated branch and should remain only a lexical resonance.

changed_reading.before: The raised neck is an incidental consequence of restraint.
changed_reading.after: The raised neck may also function as compulsory display, making the judged group visibly separable.

context_deltas.mechanism: عقل joins the faculty that restrains ignorance to the hobbling of a camel. When that inward restraint is not exercised, the focus's outward fetter can be read as its punitive replacement: the body is bound because discernment failed to bind folly.

activation_trace.role: The organ-binding collar supplies the external restraint.
Reason as what restrains from ignorance supplies the missing inward governor.
Hobbling a camel with an عقال supplies a concrete restraint homologous to the collar.
The repeated appeal to restraining reason keeps the inward faculty active near the later bodily reversal.

structural_cues: The question about using reason occurs at 36:62 and recurs at 36:68 after another forced bodily state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reason-as-restraint, a camel hobble, and the focus fetter; I infer substitution from failed inward restraint to imposed outward restraint. An alternative is simple etymological play without causal substitution.

changed_reading.before: The fetter blocks an already completed act of disbelief.
changed_reading.after: The fetter is an externalized anti-reason: imposed binding occupies the place where عقل should have restrained ignorance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus fixes head, gaze, and throat; 36:66 removes visual capacity, and 36:67 removes bodily capacity to proceed or return. The split inventory for استطاعوا adds neck extension to inability, reconnecting the later immobility directly to the focus anatomy.

activation_trace.role: The elevated neck extension supplies the first fixed body axis.
Raised head with lowered sight supplies the initial sensorimotor shutdown.
Loss of light and vision supplies explicit closure of the visual channel.
Eyesight names the unavailable capacity.
Transformation of bodily form supplies the more comprehensive shutdown.
Capacity and ability supply what the transformed bodies lack.
The split mapping's long, extended neck supplies a form-distant but exact anatomical return to the focus.
Passing onward supplies the blocked forward vector.
Returning to a prior state supplies the blocked reverse vector.

structural_cues: 36:66 and 36:67 are consecutive conditional transformations of sight and locomotion.
The focus's two result clauses already derive posture from restraint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visual erasure, bodily transformation, inability, opposite motion vectors, and a split neck-extension branch; I arrange them as progressive channel shutdown. They may instead be separate counterfactual examples of power.

changed_reading.before: The focus depicts one local restriction at the neck.
changed_reading.after: It begins a modular shutdown of agency: orientation, sight, forward motion, and return can each be closed while the body remains present.

context_deltas.mechanism: مقمحون forces the head up and sight down; ننكس supplies inversion generally and lowering or reversing the head and sight specifically. Together they expose a controlled postural axis on which the body can be forced in opposite directions.

activation_trace.role: Conversion into a bodily state supplies agency over posture.
Raising the head away from water supplies one pole of the postural axis.
Turning a thing onto its head supplies general reversal.
Lowering or reversing the head and sight supplies the opposed bodily vector.

structural_cues: Both 36:8 and 36:68 use first-person state-changing verbs followed by a bodily result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an upward forced posture and a later head-and-sight reversal; I infer one bidirectional control axis. The alternative is that aging inversion has no designed relation to the earlier collar.

changed_reading.before: The raised head is a fixed emblem with no internal contrast.
changed_reading.after: It is one pole of a reversible anatomy: the same body can be compelled upward or turned downward, so posture itself becomes an index of lost agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: Animals are made tractable for riding and eating and are given drinking places; the drinking root unexpectedly includes putting a rope in the neck and stretching the neck to look. The focus inverts that husbandry: resistant humans are neck-tethered, yet their قمح posture withdraws them from drink rather than enabling benefit.

activation_trace.role: The anatomical neck supplies the tether point.
A camel-like raised head leaving water supplies failed animal drinking behavior.
Making a difficult creature tractable supplies the husbandry relation.
Eating supplies one beneficial circulation made possible by animal tractability.
Taking liquid supplies the benefit denied by the focus posture.
Putting a rope into or around the neck supplies a direct tether image inside the drinking inventory.
Stretching the neck to look supplies the same conspicuous neck vector as مقمحون.

structural_cues: 36:71-73 forms one sequence of ownership, tractability, riding, eating, benefit, and drinking.
The focus's قمح branch explicitly evokes an animal raising its head from water.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tractable animals, food and drink, a neck-rope branch, and the focus's animal-at-water posture; I infer an inverted husbandry relation. The alternative is that the animal and human scenes only contrast gratitude with disbelief without sharing mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The collar treats people as generic prisoners.
changed_reading.after: It may invert the later livestock economy: creatures made tractable receive benefit and drink, while humans who resist are tethered into a posture that blocks the very drink before them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root holds both fixed ingress and concealed rancor; the later contrast between what is hidden and what is public activates the collar as an outward display of an inwardly lodged condition.

activation_trace.role: Fixed entry into interstices supplies the lodged inner condition.
Concealed rancor in the chest supplies the hidden affective content.
Concealing something inwardly supplies the private side of the contrast.
Making something public supplies the visible side into which the collar translates it.

structural_cues: 36:76 places concealed and declared material in an explicit parallel pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed rancor under the collar root and a later hidden/public pair; I infer externalization from inner disposition to visible restraint. A live alternative is that 36:76 asserts knowledge without explaining the collar's origin.

changed_reading.before: The fetter is wholly external and says nothing about interior state.
changed_reading.after: The visible fetter can expose what was lodged and concealed, turning inward rancor into public bodily form.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the restraint through a later drowning scene rather than through imprisonment. It remains anchored in مقمحون's explicit head-from-water branch and the focus collar, with drowning and rescue supplied by 36:43. Downstream prose should present it only as a hydrostatic counter-image, not claim that the focus literally occurs at sea.

activation_trace.role: The neck collar supplies weight and constrained movement at the imagined waterline.
Raising the head away from water supplies the waterline posture.
Drowning in water turns head elevation into a precarious survival vector.
Extraction from peril supplies the rescue that the restrained posture cannot achieve by itself.

changed_reading.before: The raised head simply refuses a drink.
changed_reading.after: Against the drowning cue, the same raised head becomes a futile attempt to stay above a waterline while the collar prevents self-rescue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain activation because a tree root branch names the space between the jaws and the verse produces fire from green wood. It remains anchored in الأذقان as the jaw meeting and in the restraint reaching that point. Downstream prose should qualify it as a lexical-material resonance and must not literalize a burning mouth or equate the jaw with the tree.

activation_trace.role: The meeting of the jaws supplies the restrained threshold.
A mouthful keeps the threshold tied to oral capacity.
The space between the two jaws supplies an exact anatomical bridge from tree to the focus chin.
Kindled fire supplies latent energy emerging from an apparently contrary material.
Ignition supplies the outward release that the jaw-reaching restraint holds in check.

changed_reading.before: The chin is only the measured endpoint of a collar.
changed_reading.after: The chin can also register a closed transformation threshold at the jaws, where latent capacity would otherwise ignite into outward action.

strongest_changes: The collar becomes the bodily execution of a fixed word and the vertical axis of the surrounding barriers.
Grain, mouth, spending, and feeding branches turn blocked intake into a failed circulation of provision.
The hand-to-neck fetter branch at 36:53 and the sealed-mouth testimony at 36:65 make the restraint juridical.
Reason-as-restraint, visual erasure, inability to proceed or return, and reversed head posture recast the focus as controlled shutdown of agency.
The drinking root's neck-rope and neck-extension branches activate an inverted husbandry reading across 36:71-73.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah exposure did more than add themes: several distant branches landed on the exact focus anatomy. جمع supplied a hand-to-neck fetter, ميز supplied neck display, عقل supplied a hobble, استطاعوا split toward neck extension, شرب supplied both a neck rope and stretched neck, and شجر supplied the space between the jaws.
remaining_uncertainties: The juridical, husbandry, and jaw-ignition readings depend on deliberately retaining form-distant branches; their mechanisms are visible but should not be promoted to exclusive interpretations.
The arrows from refused feeding to blocked intake and from failed inward عقل to outward fetter are reader-supplied causal reversals.
The packet supports both an imposed external apparatus and an externalized inner disposition without forcing a choice between them.
